answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve 1 exclusive service pipe to manage its interactions, acting like a sturdy vine that anchors the identity to a specific throughput slot. An honest participant manages one reservation effectively, while an attacker seeking to spawn 1,000 identities must procure massive, parallel infrastructure to maintain those slots, which are as hard to fake as a solid walnut. A verifier inspects the willow of session logs for occupancy overlaps.
